quarterly_data.signal: Nanya's Q3 2026 results release: the company plans a 3D wafer packaging and testing fab at Pingtung Science Park, incorporating advanced 3D IC technologies including through silicon vias (TSVs) and wafer stacking, by the end of 2028; it expects to begin customer qualification of 1C in the first quarter of 2027; its AI infrastructure-related business (servers, networking, storage and system management solutions) currently accounts for more than 20% of total revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: 3D wafer packaging and testing fab by the end of 2028; 1C customer qualification from Q1 2027
